title: GTM Traffic-Light Orchestration for New Model Catalog Additions
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create and execute a cross-functional GTM orchestration plan for adding new model variants to the catalog. The deliverable is a traffic-light style runbook that tracks readiness across Catalog publishing, Benchmarks & Evals, Docs/SDK samples, Release Notes, Marketing/Announcements, and Engineering rollout readiness. The runbook must be actionable for PMs, Eng, Design, Docs, and Growth to run a coordinated debut with clear owners, fallbacks, and communication templates.
acceptance_criteria: Traffic-light matrix (red/amber/green) published in Confluence and linked from the model catalog entry
Benchmark suite results posted with baseline comparison and at least one regression signoff from Applied ML
Release notes draft approved by PM, legal, and security, with a templated snippet for SDK and API changelog
Console catalogue entry staged with example request/response and cost/latency annotations
Marketing announcement draft + comms calendar scheduled and assigned
Rollout play (canary/region sequencing) documented with fallback triggers and ENG on-call assignment
comments: 2026-02-19 - Kickoff with Applied ML, Eng, Docs, Design. Agreed to use traffic-light matrix instead of linear checklist to surface blockers faster. Action: Liam to scaffold matrix and link to catalog entry.

2026-02-24 - Engineering note from Priya Rao: kernel/quantization variant needs smoke tests on dedicated pool (ENG-2107). Added dependency on dedicated autoscale window. Impact on timeline: +3 business days if dedicated pool not available.
2026-02-28 - Design review (Mara Nguyen): Request sample UI screenshot for Console catalog card showing latency and cost; provided two options. Chose compact layout to reduce cognitive load.

2026-03-03 - Applied ML (Diego Alvarez) uploaded benchmarks: internal dashboard link showing 95th-latency and throughput across seq-lengths. Noted slight quality delta on long-form summarization tests; proposed fallback to a smaller context variant for low-latency tiers.

2026-03-05 - PM decision: proceed with rollout gate that requires no more than 10% quality regression on targeted evals versus baseline. If exceeded, postpone public announcement and enable internal-only listing.
2026-03-08 - Docs update (Sara Kim): Release notes draft created and posted. Need legal review for third-party model attribution. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake_release_notes_draft
2026-03-10 - Engineering PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4598 - adds model variant aliasing and canned fallback policy. Requested review from runtime owners and SRE.
2026-03-11 - Cross-functional sync: Marketing wants an embargo until benchmarks hit green. Action: PM to produce a short decision matrix to unblock marketing copy for internal staging.

2026-03-12 - Update: Traffic-light matrix set to amber overall (Benchmarks: amber; Docs: green; Console: amber; Release Notes: green). Next milestone: benchmark regression signoff or a mitigation plan by 2026-03-18.
